text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. With the entry 
of Katsuragi Ace and Mr. C.B., Tokyo 
Racecourse was ablaze with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the stands were Symboli Rudolf, and 
Mejiro Ramonu, who had achieved the 
first-ever Triple Tiara in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid the swirling ambitions of the strong 
contenders ready to race— the highly 
anticipated Japan Cup gets underway.
